widgets.title: Spacer
widgets.description: Empty vertical space with a responsive height.

widgets.title: Star Rating
widgets.description: A star rating on a 5 or 10 scale with partial stars, marked/unmarked colors and an optional title.

widgets.title: Stripe button
widgets.description: Take payments with a Stripe Payment Link, or a Checkout Session created on the server.

controls.label: Mode
controls.description: Payment Link: paste a link from your Stripe dashboard. Checkout: the server creates a session with the secret key from Zadex > Settings.

controls.label: Success URL
controls.description: Defaults to this page with ?zadex_payment=success.

controls.label: Error message
controls.default: The payment could not be started. Please try again.

widgets.title: SVG
widgets.description: Inline SVG markup with size, fill color and an optional link. Scripts and event handlers are removed.

controls.label: SVG code
controls.description: Paste inline SVG markup. Scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are stripped.

widgets.title: Table of Contents
widgets.description: Lists the headings of the page with links to them: nested or flat, numbered, collapsible, sticky, with smooth scrolling and the current heading highlighted.

controls.label: Title HTML tag
controls.description: A heading tag here is never listed in the table itself.

controls.label: Nested list
controls.description: Lower levels are indented under the heading they belong to.

controls.label: Container selector
controls.description: Only headings inside this element. Empty: the whole page content.

controls.label: Exclude selector
controls.description: Headings matching it (or inside a match) are skipped. Headings without an id get one automatically.

controls.label: Scroll offset (px)
controls.description: Space kept above the heading, e.g. the height of a sticky header.

controls.label: Sticky
controls.description: Stays visible while the column scrolls (the column must be taller than the box).

widgets.title: Tabs
widgets.description: Tabbed content. Each tab is a droppable container; horizontal or vertical navigation with keyboard support.

controls.label: Default active tab
controls.description: 1 = first tab.

widgets.title: Taxonomy Filter
widgets.description: Filters a Loop Grid or Loop Carousel on the page by the terms of a taxonomy, without reloading the page.

controls.label: Loop
controls.description: The Loop Grid / Loop Carousel of this page to filter.

controls.label: Only these terms
controls.description: Slugs, comma separated. Empty = every term with posts.

widgets.title: Template
widgets.description: Inserts a saved template (My templates) or a theme template. Edit the template once and every page using it updates.

controls.label: Template
controls.description: Saved templates are created with "Save as template…" (container menu) or "Save page as template".

widgets.title: Testimonial
widgets.description: A customer quote with image, name and role. Image above, inside the meta row or aside the content.

controls.label: Content
controls.default: Zadex made building our site a joy. Fast, clean and a pleasure to use every day.

widgets.title: Testimonial Carousel
widgets.description: Customer quotes in a slider: content, image, name and title with default or speech-bubble skins and five image layouts.

default.content: Zadex made building our site a joy. Fast, clean and a pleasure to use every day.
default.name: Jane Doe
default.title: CEO, Northwind

default.content: We rebuilt our landing pages in a weekend and they load twice as fast.
default.name: Omar Haddad
default.title: Marketing lead

default.content: The cleanest markup of any page builder we tried. Our developers finally agree with marketing.
default.name: Lena Park
default.title: CTO, Brightside

widgets.title: Text
widgets.description: Rich text with bold, italic, links, lists and headings. Double-click to edit inline.

controls.label: Content
controls.default: Add your text here. Double-click to edit it inline, or use the editor in this panel.

widgets.title: Text Path
widgets.description: Text that follows a curve: wave, arc, circle, line or your own SVG path.

controls.label: SVG path (d)
controls.description: The d attribute of an SVG <path>.

widgets.title: Toggle
widgets.description: Collapsible list where every item can be open at once; all items start closed. Same items and styling as the Accordion.

widgets.title: Upsells
widgets.description: The current product's up-sells, as product cards.

widgets.title: Video
widgets.description: YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted video with autoplay, mute, loop, poster image and aspect ratio.

controls.label: Autoplay
controls.description: Browsers only autoplay muted videos.

controls.label: Privacy mode
controls.description: Uses youtube-nocookie.com.

controls.label: Poster
controls.description: Shown with a play button until the visitor clicks; the player then loads.

widgets.title: Video Playlist
widgets.description: A video player with a clickable list of YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted videos, thumbnails, durations and autoplay of the next video.

controls.label: Thumbnail
controls.description: YouTube videos use their own thumbnail when empty.

controls.label: List position
controls.description: The list moves below the video on mobile.

controls.label: Autoplay next video
controls.description: Plays the next video when one ends (after the visitor started playback).

controls.label: Privacy mode
controls.description: Uses youtube-nocookie.com.

controls.label: List height (stacked)
controls.description: Used when the list sits below the video. Beside the video the list matches the player height.
